description_en: This phalcā is a recent reconstruction. The materials used are largely new and the design has been much reduced. Only the back and side walls exhibit the oldmā apābrickwork although the traditionaljhingatiroof was also reused. The undecorated columns are new as is the roof framing. The front and back walls were rebuilt using newdāci apābricks, whilst parts of the interior walls have been covered with cement plaster.Five historic statues have been placed in newly made niches on the eastern wall. These are (from left to right):1) Guhyasaṃvara: This deity has nine heads and sixteen hands and stands on a pedestal engraved with images of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśvara and Indra.2) Gaṇeśa: This seated Gaṇeśa has four arms. He is shown holding a garland and radish in his right hands and an axe and a vessel of sweet balls in his left hands.3) Mañjuśrī: A four-handed Mañjuśrī holds a sword and an arrow in his right hands and the Prajñāpāramitā scripture and a bow in his left hands.4) Mahākāla: Mahākāla has two hands and is standing on a corpse holding a ritual knife (kartṛ) and a begging bowl (kapāla pātra).5) Sarasvatī: The statue of Sarasvatī is shown holding avīṇāin her left hand.
description_ne: यो फल्चाको खोपाहरूमा पाँचवटा मूर्तिहरू स्थापना गरिएका छन् । ती हुन्-गुह्यसम्वर: यो मूर्तिको नौवटा टाउकाहरू र सोह्रवटा हातहरू छन् र यसको पादशिलामा ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश्वर र ईन्द्र कुँदिएका छन् ।गणेश: यो चार हात भएको गणेशको दायाँतर्फका हातहरूले माला र मूला तथा बायाँतर्फका हातहरूमा बन्चरो तथा मिष्ठान्नको भाँडो  लिएका छन् ।मञ्जुश्री: यो चार हात भएको मञ्जुश्रीले दायाँतर्फका हातहरूमा खड्ग र वाण तथा बायाँतर्फका हातहरूमा प्रज्ञापारमिता पुस्तक र धनु धारण गरेका छन् ।महाँकाल: शवमाथि उभिएको यस मूर्तिले हातहरूमा कर्तृ र कपाल धारण गरेको छ ।सरस्वती: ईनले हातमा वीणा धारण गरेकी छीन् ।
brick_type: dāci apā (conical veneer brick), mā apā (regular fired brick)
monument_assessment: Rebuilt, Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)
references: REFERENCES Śākya, Hemaraja. Mahābuddha Mandira: Saṃkṣipta Itihāsa . Lalitpur: Cakrarāja Śākya and friends, VS 2045. (CE 1998). Śākya, Hemrāja. Śivadevasaṃskārita Rudravarṇa Mahāvihāra: Chagū Adhyayana . Lalitpur, 1994.
